name: JOJO Limited
summary: JOJO Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the event management business in India. It is also involved in the entertainment; produce, buy, and sell of films; and pharma trading business. JOJO Limited was formerly known as Madhuveer Com 18 Network Limited and changed its name to JOJO Limited in March 2026. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
